t: Specifically designed to fit hinges. Boasting a twin and single thread on the same screw, they are fully threaded to provide a secure fix. The Tri-Lock shank ensures a balanced straight insertion for a perfect flush fit. With a hardened core to prevent snapping and a plain angled head for a flush fit. No pilot hole is required. Net coat chrome-plated. Countersunk head.
b: Double-Countersunk without Ribs to Sit Flush in Hinge
